# 🚀 Deployment checklist

- [ ] Correct commit and branch selected.
- [ ] Dependencies installed from lockfile.
- [ ] Docs validation succeeds.
- [ ] Application tests run where present.
- [ ] Production build succeeds.
- [ ] No secrets or real contact data included.
- [ ] Hosting output directory configured as `build/`.
- [ ] Smoke test completed on the deployed site.
- [ ] Browser console reviewed.
- [ ] Rollback approach recorded.
